paite: Babulon tungtang, Kaldai mite gam tungtang a zawlnei Jeremiah kam a TOUPA thugen:
heading: Babulon Luh A Omna
english: The word that Yahweh spoke concerning Babylon, concerning the land of the Chaldeans, by Jeremiah the prophet.

paite: Namte lak ah gen unla, puang un, puanzak khai in, puang un, sel kei un, Babulon lak ahita. Bel azahlak a, Merodak mulkimna in adim a, milimte ase khinta.
english: Declare among the nations and publish, and set up a standard; publish, and don’t conceal: say, Babylon is taken, Bel is disappointed, Merodach is dismayed; her images are disappointed, her idols are dismayed.

paite: Mallam a kipan amah nam khat in ahon sual a, huai in agam ahihgawp ding a, huai ah kuamah ateng nawn kei ding ua; ataikek ua, mi leh sate leng amang khinta uhi.
english: For out of the north there comes up a nation against her, which shall make her land desolate, and none shall dwell therein: they are fled, they are gone, both man and animal.

paite: Huai nite in leh huai hun chiang in Israel suante ahong pai ding ua, amau leh Judah tate toh; kap kawm in ahong pai ding ua, TOUPA a Pathian uh azong ding uh; chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
heading: Saltanna A Pan Israel Kik Nawnna
english: In those days, and in that time, says Yahweh, the children of Israel shall come, they and the children of Judah together; they shall go on their way weeping, and shall seek Yahweh their God.

paite: Zion lam nga in akalsuanna ding uh adong ding ua, "Kisa un, tangtawn thukhun mangngilh nawn lou ding in TOUPA hong len un," achi ding uh.
english: They shall inquire concerning Zion with their faces turned toward it, saying, Come, and join yourselves to Yahweh in an everlasting covenant that shall not be forgotten.

paite: Ka mite zaw belam mang ahi ua; amau ching mite'n apimang ua, mualte ah apaimangsak ua, tang a pan mual dungte ah apai ua, ahuang uh amangngilh khinta uhi.
english: My people have been lost sheep: their shepherds have caused them to go astray; they have turned them away on the mountains; they have gone from mountain to hill; they have forgotten their resting place.

paite: Amu peuh in ane zel ua, amelmate un, i gilou kei, TOUPA dikna omna apipute uh lamet TOUPA hilhial tung a thil ahihkhelh ziak ahi, achi uhi.
english: All who found them have devoured them; and their adversaries said, We are not guilty, because they have sinned against Yahweh, the habitation of righteousness, even Yahweh, the hope of their fathers.

paite: Babulon sung a kipan in taikhia unla, Kaldaite gam a kipan paikhia un, kelhon lak a keltalte bang in om un.
english: Flee out of the midst of Babylon, and go forth out of the land of the Chaldeans, and be as the male goats before the flocks.

paite: Ngai dih ua, Babulon hong sual ding in mal gam a kipan nam honpi thupitak kikaikhawm ka tokthou ding a, amah dou ding in akisa ding ua; huai a kipan in lak ahi ding uh; athalte uh lah galbawl siamtak vuaksuak ngei lou bang ahi ding uh.
english: For, behold, I will stir up and cause to come up against Babylon a company of great nations from the north country; and they shall set themselves in array against her; from there she shall be taken: their arrows shall be as of an expert mighty man; none shall return in vain.

paite: Huan Kaldai loh in a-om ding, alok mite atai ngial ding uh, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Chaldea shall be a prey: all who prey on her shall be satisfied, says Yahweh.

paite: Kipak mah le uchin, nuamsa mah le uchin, aw ka goutan lok mite aw, lou lak a bawngla takhialkhial bang leh sakoltal ham ngekngek bang himah le uchin;
heading: Babulon Pukna
english: Because you are glad, because you rejoice, O you who plunder my heritage, because you are wanton as a heifer that treads out the grain, and neigh as strong horses;

paite: Na nu uh ahong zum mahmah ding a, nou hon suangnu ahong zahlak ding hi. Ngai un, namte lak a nuainungpen, gamdai, gamkeu, gamvuak ahi ding.
english: your mother shall be utterly disappointed; she who bore you shall be confounded: behold, she shall be the least of the nations, a wilderness, a dry land, and a desert.

paite: TOUPA hehna ziak in luahmi a-om kei ding a, ase vek zaw ding hi, Babulon hoh peuhmah amulkimsak ding a, asiatna tengteng ziak in atek ding uhi.
english: Because of the wrath of Yahweh she shall not be inhabited, but she shall be wholly desolate: everyone who goes by Babylon shall be astonished, and hiss at all her plagues.

paite: Thalpeu tawimi tengteng aw, Babulon umsuak in kivual unla, kap unla, thalte chil kei un, TOUPA tung ah akhialta uhi.
english: Set yourselves in array against Babylon all around, all you who bend the bow; shoot at her, spare no arrows: for she has sinned against Yahweh.

paite: Akimvel in awng unla, amah-le-amah akipeta, akulhte apukta a, abaangte achimta, TOUPA phulakna ahi ngal a, atung ah phu la unla, ahih bangbang in atung ah hih un.
english: Shout against her all around: she has submitted herself; her bulwarks are fallen, her walls are thrown down; for it is the vengeance of Yahweh: take vengeance on her; as she has done, do to her.

paite: Babulon a kipan chi thehmi attan unla, buhlak lai a kawite tawimi toh, nuaisiahna namsau lau in amau mite lam azuan chiat ding ua, amau gam chiat ah atai ding uh.
english: Cut off the sower from Babylon, and him who handles the sickle in the time of harvest: for fear of the oppressing sword they shall turn everyone to his people, and they shall flee everyone to his own land.

paite: Israel bel belam dalhzak ahi a; humpinelkaite'n adelhmang ua; Assuria kumpipa'n amah ane phot a, atawp in Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in aguhte ahaizanta hi.
heading: Saltanna A Pan Israel Kik Nawnna
english: Israel is a hunted sheep; the lions have driven him away: first, the king of Assyria devoured him; and now at last Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has broken his bones.

paite: Huaiziak in sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi: Ngai un, Assuria kumpipa ka gawt bang in Babulon kumpipa leh agam ka gawt ding.
english: Therefore thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel: Behold, I will punish the king of Babylon and his land, as I have punished the king of Assyria.

paite: Huan Israel agantatna ah ka pi nawn ding a, Karmel leh Bashan ah ata ding a, Ephraim tang ah leh Gilead ah amah ata ding hi.
english: I will bring Israel again to his pasture, and he shall feed on Carmel and Bashan, and his soul shall be satisfied on the hills of Ephraim and in Gilead.

paite: Huai nite leh huai hun chiang in Israel thulimlouhnate azong ding ua, muh ding a-om kei ding; Judah thilhihkhelhte leng muh ding a-om sam kei ding; omsun ding a ka koihte ngaidam ding ka hi ngal a, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: In those days, and in that time, says Yahweh, the iniquity of Israel shall be sought for, and there shall be none; and the sins of Judah, and they shall not be found: for I will pardon them whom I leave as a remnant.

paite: Merathim gam sual un, agam leh Pekod luah mite mahmah that unla, hihgam sipsip un, thu ka hon piak bangbang in hih un, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
heading: Babulon Tung A TOUPA Thukhenna
english: Go up against the land of Merathaim, even against it, and against the inhabitants of Pekod: kill and utterly destroy after them, says Yahweh, and do according to all that I have commanded you.

paite: Huai gam ah gal husa a-om, siatna thupi mahmah husa toh.
english: A sound of battle is in the land, and of great destruction.

paite: Khovel pumpi sek kitam in, nak keknen hi na tel e; namte lak ah Babulon kinaksiat hi na mai e!
english: How is the hammer of the whole earth cut apart and broken! how is Babylon become a desolation among the nations!

paite: Aw Babilon, nang ding in thang na kam a, thei lou a awk na hita ve; muhkhiak leh mat in na omta, TOUPA na sual ziak in.
english: I have laid a snare for you, and you are also taken, Babylon, and you weren’t aware: you are found, and also caught, because you have striven against Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA'N agalvan bawm ahongta, ahehna vanzatte alakhia a, Toupa, sepaihte' TOUPA'N Kaldaite gam ah hih ding anei hi.
english: Yahweh has opened his armory, and has brought forth the weapons of his indignation; for the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, has a work to do in the land of the Chaldeans.

paite: Gamgi tawp pek a kipan in hon sual unla, athil koihkhawmna innte hong vek unla, paikhawm un, hihse vek unla, abangmah hawi kei un.
english: Come against her from the utmost border; open her storehouses; cast her up as heaps, and destroy her utterly; let nothing of her be left.

paite: Abawngtal tuaite that vek unla, goh in om uhen. Atung uh gik hi na tel e! Ani uh, amaute gawtna ni mahmah ahong tungta hi.
english: Kill all her bulls; let them go down to the slaughter: woe to them! for their day has come, the time of their visitation.

paite: TOUPA i Pathian phulak, atempul phulakna ngei Zion a gen ding a Babulon a kipan a taikhete leh taimangte husa ngei.
english: The voice of those who flee and escape out of the land of Babylon, to declare in Zion the vengeance of Yahweh our God, the vengeance of his temple.

paite: Babulon sual ding in thalkap siam, thalpeu zangmi tengteng samkhawm un; akimvel in buk bawl unla, kuamah suakta kei uhen. Athilhih bangbang in thuk un, ahihsa bang tengteng amah tung ah hih un; TOUPA, Israel Mi Siangthou lah achou ngam hi.
english: Call together the archers against Babylon, all those who bend the bow; encamp against her all around; let none of it escape: recompense her according to her work; according to all that she has done, do to her; for she has been proud against Yahweh, against the Holy One of Israel.

paite: Huaiziak in akholakte ah tangvalte apuk ding ua, galkapmi tengteng huai ni in amangthang ding uh, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Therefore her young men will fall in her streets, and all her men of war will be brought to silence in that day, says Yahweh.

paite: Ngai in, nang mikisathei, ka hon dou ahi, Toupa, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi hi. Na ni ahong tungta, na gawtna ding ni mah,
english: Behold, I am against you, you proud one, says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies; for your day has come, the time that I will visit you.

paite: Huan mikisathei akisui in apuk ding a, kuamah in aphong kei ding ua, akhopite ah mei ka khah ding a, akimvel a om tengteng ka kangsiangsak vek ding.
english: The proud one shall stumble and fall, and none shall raise him up; and I will kindle a fire in his cities, and it shall devour all who are around him.

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Israel suante leh Judah tate nuaisiah in a-om khawmta ua; sal a amaute pi mite tengteng in amau alen tinten ua, akhah nuam kei uhi. Amaute tanpa bel ahat a; amin sepaihte' TOUPA ahi.
english: Thus says Yahweh of Armies: The children of Israel and the children of Judah are oppressed together; and all who took them captive hold them fast; they refuse to let them go.

paite: Amah amau lam ah apang a, Babulon a tengte hihbuai in, leitung a khawlna atuttheihna ding in.
english: Their Redeemer is strong; Yahweh of Armies is his name: he will thoroughly plead their cause, that he may give rest to the earth, and disquiet the inhabitants of Babylon.

paite: Kaldai mite tung ah namsau aleng hi, Babulon a tengte, aheutute uh leh amipilte uh tung ah leng, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: A sword is on the Chaldeans, says Yahweh, and on the inhabitants of Babylon, and on her princes, and on her wise men.

paite: Mizuautheite tung ah namsau, mihai ahong suak ding uh; agalkapmi tung ah namsau, alunglel khin ding uh.
english: A sword is on the boasters, and they shall become fools; a sword is on her mighty men, and they shall be dismayed.

paite: Asakolte uh leh kangtalaite uh tung ah namsau, asung a mi kilak hel tengtengte tung ah leng, numei bang phet ahong hi ding uh; agou thil tung ah namsau lok in a-om maimai ding uhi.
english: A sword is on their horses, and on their chariots, and on all the mixed people who are in the midst of her; and they shall become as women: a sword is on her treasures, and they shall be robbed.

paite: Atuite kang in akeu khin a, milimte gam lah ahi ngal a, milimte lah ahailoh uhi.
english: A drought is on her waters, and they shall be dried up; for it is a land of engraved images, and they are mad over idols.

paite: Huaiziak in gamdai gam sahangte, ngiate toh huai ah ateng ding ua, ostrikte leng huai ah ateng ding uh; luah in a-om ngei nawn kei ding; suan tengteng pha in leng luah in a-om kei ding hi.
english: Therefore the wild animals of the desert with the wolves shall dwell there, and the ostriches shall dwell therein: and it shall be no more inhabited forever; neither shall it be lived in from generation to generation.

paite: Pathian in Sodom leh Gomorrah leh akho invengte ahihsiat bangbang in; huai ah kuamah atengta kei ding ua, mihing tapa kuamah in aveh nawnta kei ding uh, TOUPA thupawt in achi hi.
english: As when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbor cities of it, says Yahweh, so shall no man dwell there, neither shall any son of man live therein.

paite: Ngai un, mallam gam a pan mite ahong ua, mun tawp a kipan nam thupitak leh kumpipa tampi ahong kuan uhi.
english: Behold, a people comes from the north; and a great nation and many kings shall be stirred up from the uttermost parts of the earth.

paite: Thalpeu leh tei atawi ua, hiamgamtak, zahngaihna nei lou ahi uh. Ahusa uh tuipi ging huhu bang ahi a, sakol tung ah atuang ua, michih galkapmi bang a kivan in, Babulon tanu aw, nang ahong sual ding uhi.
english: They lay hold on bow and spear; they are cruel, and have no mercy; their voice roars like the sea; and they ride on horses, everyone set in array, as a man to the battle, against you, daughter of Babylon.

paite: Ahusa uh za in Babulon kumpipa khut azawgawpta a, numei nauvei lai natna bang in, natna thupitak in amanta hi.
english: The king of Babylon has heard the news of them, and his hands wax feeble: anguish has taken hold of him, pains as of a woman in labor.

paite: Ngai un, Jordan gammang a kipan humpinelkai, kahna mun a ahong tou bang in ahong paitou ding a; amah a kipan in amaute ka taimangsak pah ding; atung a thunei ding ka ut-ut ka sep ding. Kei bang kua a-om a! Kua'n sep ding. Kei bang kuakua a-om a? Kua'n ahia hunbi hon sehsak ding? Belamchingmi kua ahia ka ma a dingh ding?
english: Behold, the enemy shall come up like a lion from the pride of the Jordan against the strong habitation: for I will suddenly make them run away from it; and whoever is chosen, him will I appoint over it: for who is like me? and who will appoint me a time? and who is the shepherd who can stand before me?

paite: Huaiziak in Babulon tung ah TOUPA thuhilh, Kaldai mite tung a athilseh ngaikhia un. Ganhon noute ngei kaihmang in a-om ding ua, gan khahna mun a mite amulkimsak ding.
english: Therefore hear the counsel of Yahweh, that he has taken against Babylon; and his purposes, that he has purposed against the land of the Chaldeans: Surely they shall drag them away, even the little ones of the flock; surely he shall make their habitation desolate over them.

paite: Babulon lakna husa ah lei aling ding a, akahna husa namte lak a zak ahi ding hi.
english: At the noise of the taking of Babylon the earth trembles, and the cry is heard among the nations.
